notes: New WebView2 interface: home, Caption Studio, progress, review editor and results run in one smooth window.
Review editor with waveform, live reading-speed meters, filters, split/merge/delete and instant local re-cuts.
Selection files, presets, cues and SRT/.cap output are byte-identical to the previous editor (covered by tests).
The classic interface remains as a fallback. Real Resolve and ElevenLabs runs of the new interface are not yet verified.
